name: BUPT guidewire robot
full_name: BUPT guidewire feeding robot (friction-wheel push-pull, gear rotation) used for deep-RL guidewire feeding on a vessel phantom
group: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, School of Automation (Deai Yang, Jingzhou Song, Yuhang Hu) (yang2022_guidewire p. 1287; Crossref affiliations)
versions: single paper (yang2022_guidewire, ICMA 2022); the robot is described only in its Sec. IV-A
target_anatomy: abdominal-aorta target in a vessel phantom with pumped water at a controlled temperature (Sec. IV-A, IV-C, Figs. 1-2, 7); detection images from the phantom's femoral artery and aortic arch (Sec. IV-B)
translation_detail: friction-roller: 'It moves the guidewire forward or backward via a pair of friction wheels clamping it' (Sec. IV-A)
rotation_detail: 'The rotation of the guidewire around the central axis is achieved by a pair of rotating gears' (Sec. IV-A)
force_sensing: none (force from the motor current proposed as future work, Sec. V)
haptics_leader: none: an autonomous SAC agent on a server sends (push-pull, rotation) actions (Sec. IV-A, Fig. 2)
imaging_compat: camera above the transparent phantom; the YOLOv5s tip detector was also run on angiographic images (Fig. 5); fluoroscopy with the robot N.R.
validation_detail: phantom: two training-and-test experiments on the physical phantom, (1) push-pull only, 500 episodes of <= 150 steps in 2.5 h, converged after about 260 episodes; (2) push-pull plus rotation, 500 episodes in 4.2 h, converged after about 300; test runs reached the target within the 40-pixel (about 5 mm) termination criterion (Sec. IV-C, Figs. 8-13). Number of test runs N.R.
key_numbers: push-pull accuracy 1 mm, rotation accuracy 5 deg (Sec. IV-A); action limits +/-20 mm, +/-90 deg (Sec. III-A); feeding error < 5 mm, tip detection >= 92.9 % (Abstract); YOLOv5s 23 ms per image (Sec. IV-B)
sim2real_detail: none found: the policy is trained on the physical phantom without a simulator ('To avoid the error caused by the virtual simulation environment, we built an interventional surgery experimental platform based on vessel phantom', Sec. IV-A)
